recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future work group decision changes the timezone extension link or its representation.
issue_request: FHIR-38006 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked the date, dateTime, instant, and time datatype descriptions to distinguish timezone offsets from actual time zone identifiers, including a note that dateTime and instant can carry actual timezone codes using http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/timezone.
initial_application: Commit 96a8f6cf4179999f7df02e3648b33562c5b5bdf0 applied the issue to source/datatypes.html by adding offset wording for date, dateTime, instant, and time and adding timezone-extension notes for dateTime and instant. Later editorial changes normalized the spelling to "timezone offset" and adjusted link syntax without changing the approved meaning.
additional_context: MnM minutes from 2022-09-14 record FHIR-38006 as "Will Update Spec" with a 3-0-0 vote. source/fhir.ini maps primitive datatypes to datatypes.html, confirming the checked prose is in current build scope. The timezone extension definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack, and core still references its canonical URL from datatypes.html and oids.ini. Community searches found no conflicting FHIR-38006 discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The combined branch already says date has no timezone offset, dateTime requires a timezone offset when hours and minutes are specified, instant includes a timezone offset, and time must not include a timezone offset; dateTime and instant also mention the timezone extension for actual timezone codes.
